LanguageData.RAV_MaLiangStylus.label: Ma Liang's Stylus
LanguageData.RAV_MaLiangStylus.description:
A legendary stylus shimmering with quantum radiance.

Usage: Select a colonist -> Right-click the stylus -> Select "Materialize Portrait".
(Prerequisite: The colonist must have an active portrait set in the [AiVinci Gallery]).
LanguageData.RimDigital_PhotoFrame.label: Quantum Portrait
LanguageData.RimDigital_PhotoFrame.description: A materialized AI artwork encased in a quantum stasis field. It displays the unique charm of a colonist. Can be placed anywhere to decorate the colony.
